svg.title: Explicit FFT limb grouping, signed limbs, fusion and rounding
svg.text: FFT LIMB ROUTING / SIGN CONTROL / EXACT FUSION
Real-product lanes, not complex-butterfly throughput. Four 16x16 leaves form one raw 32x32 tile product.
T0 | T1 | ... | T15: one raw 32x32 product per tile
4 groups of 4 tiles; 2x2 partial products per lane
32-bit limbs: a_i, b_j; only each operand's most-significant limb is signed.
Tile(i,j) returns the raw a_i*b_j product with a signed container.
Within a tile, apply the same rule to the high 16-bit half.
sum( raw_product(i,j) << (32*(i+j)) ), modulo the retained width.
Terms whose shift is outside the retained width contribute zero.
Round once per REAL product; the 3M collector receives p0,p1,p2.
W128/Q64.64 follows the pinned R8 contract. W32/Q16.16 and W64/Q32.32 are separate contracts, not PQC-accuracy claims.
Grouping and sign tags are explicit design requirements; this drawing does not introduce a new RTL implementation.
